rubric.role_summary: Senior, hands-on partner operations and systems role overseeing partnership technology, processes, reporting, internal tooling, and data-informed partner strategy.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior, hands-on partner operations and systems role overseeing partnership technology, processes, reporting, internal tooling, and data-informed partner strategy.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- 7+ years in partner operations, revenue operations, or a related operations function.
- Experience owning a partner or revenue operations tech stack.
- Experience managing a small team or dotted-line relationships across regions or sub-functions.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with HubSpot custom partner objects and multi-touch attribution, Clazar for cloud co-sell, and Linear for project management.
- Background in a developer-tools or platform business with a partner-driven go-to-market motion.
- Prior experience building internal tools or scripts, including informal work before AI-assisted development became mainstream.
- 7+ years in partner operations, revenue operations, or a related operations function, including designing a program at scale.
- Ownership of a partner or revenue tech stack, including build, buy, or migration decisions rather than administration alone.
- Hands-on AI-assisted development experience using Claude Code or a similar tool to scope, review, and ship working solutions.
- Partner economics expertise, including rev-share modeling and LTV by partner type, applicable to deal structuring.
- A track record of shaping strategic decisions, not solely implementing them.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): US West. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
